title: Where does Dubai's tap water come from?
note: This reel explains the science only. Every drawing is a generic diagram, not a real place.

facts.said: Dubai's tap water starts as seawater with the salt taken out.
One way is to boil it: heat the seawater, the steam rises, the salt stays behind, and the cooled steam is fresh water.

sources.name: Membranes journal via PubMed Central, seawater reverse osmosis review (2021)

facts.said: The other way is to squeeze it: pumps push seawater against a membrane at around 60 times normal air pressure.

sources.name: Membranes journal via PubMed Central, seawater reverse osmosis review (2021)

facts.note: The review gives 5 to 7 megapascals, which is about 50 to 70 times normal air pressure.

facts.said: Water gets through the membrane. Over 99% of the salt does not.
The salty leftover goes back to the sea.

sources.name: WateReuse Association, Seawater Concentrate Management (white paper)
Science Times, How desalination plants use reverse osmosis and manage brine (Apr 2026)

facts.said: Squeezing takes less energy than boiling.
Minerals go back in, because very pure water tastes flat and is hard on pipes.

sources.name: Omya, Why remineralization makes drinking water safe
World Health Organization, Safe Drinking-water from Desalination (2011)
